name: Shark
desc: A shark patrolling the frame — swims across, turns, swims back — with sweeping tail, gill slits, rolling jaw with teeth (menace dial), pectoral fin, bubble trail and an optional remora tagging along. finOnly mode reduces it to a dorsal fin cutting the surface with a wake. Styles: great white, hammerhead, friendly cartoon, neon, pale ghost shark.

finOnly.doc: >0.5 = only the dorsal fin at the surface
